question_record.context: A security incident was detected where a process was injected with potentially malicious code on July 4th, 2024, at 22:35:02 UTC. The process injection may indicate suspicious code being run in the target process memory, which could lead to abnormal behaviors such as opening a listening port or connecting to a command and control server.
question_record.question: Following the initial alert regarding process injection, an internal phishing campaign was detected. Can you identify the Azure Active Directory (AAD) User ID associated with the compromised account that sent phishing emails internally on July 7th, 2024?
solution: A process was injected with potentially malicious code by the user with AadUserId `a2d0f7c2-b0a0-43bd-bce0-27d8ae3be4d0`.
An internal phishing campaign was observed, where a user with AadUserId `28058d92-fc24-4869-9231-6546a34b00f2` sent phishing emails inside the organization.

41.name: A process was injected with potentially malicious code
41.description:
A process has injected code into another process, indicating suspicious code being run in the target process memory. Injection is often used to hide malicious code execution within a trusted process. 
As a result, the target process may exhibit abnormal behaviors such as opening a listening port or connecting to a command and control server.

88.name: Internal phishing lexpaign
88.description: A user was observed to have sent phishing email from this device to recipients inside the organization. The user account might have been compromised in an attempt by an attacker to move laterally inside the organization. This alert was triggered based on a Microsoft Defender for Office 365 alert.

interpretation.scope: official graph witness, not a proof of causality, actor identity or autonomous planning

       o.GraphValue AS value, o.RawComponents, o.Roles, o.SourceRowHash,
       i.GraphValue AS matched_input
FROM LTMInputEvidence i
JOIN LTMEntityEvidence o ON o.SourceRowHash = i.SourceRowHash
WHERE i.AlertTitle = %s
  AND i.Concept = 'Account_AAD_ID' AND o.Concept = 'Account_AAD_ID'
  AND i.GraphValue IN (%s)
ORDER BY o.AlertId, o.SourceRowHash, o.EntityIndex, o.GraphValue, i.GraphValue
LIMIT 501
